name: JONAH
canonical: Jonah the prophet, son of Amittai, a Hebrew man of about fifty, weathered olive skin, a haggard storm-worn face, soaked dark hair and a dripping tangled beard, wide terrified eyes, robed in a sodden coarse tunic and mantle clinging wet, strands of sea-weed wrapped about him
